pr.title: Add automatic card pictures and a live board workspace
pr.body: ## Summary Parents building a board on master can use emoji and personal photos, but a generic truck emoji cannot distinguish a dump truck from other vehicles. AI drafts also share a modal with the conversation, leaving less room to review the board while refining it. This change adds automatic picture selection and a full-page draft workspace. Automatic keeps accurate emoji, fills gaps with licensed library artwork, and generates an illustration only when a gap still needs one. Pictures appear as they finish; parents can stop work, adjust source choices, and explicitly save the reviewed draft. Failed picture work keeps a usable emoji or existing saved picture. Photos and protected pictures survive board-wide changes, and downloaded PNGs remain available offline. New board opens the conversation directly; Build manually is a separate entry. Sending or recording uses an inline data-use explanation. Source choices are available for the draft, board, card, and new-board defaults. This diff also includes the web introduction at `/`, with the application at `/app` and unchanged entry behavior for existing installed web apps. **Target:** `master` at `5d72992c77fbb09195518e257d799501b7db4d04`; no parent PR. Review PR6 before dependent #13. Current head: `846311d3ba568630d3f014701a04f2142860abac`. [Picture behavior and configuration](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/846311d3ba568630d3f014701a04f2142860abac/docs/PICTURES.md). ## Test plan and behavior evidence | Scenario | Intended outcome and actual observation | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | | Existing library; request “Cow, sheep, and a dump truck” | Keep the two accurate animal emoji and improve only the truck. The production web app requested one picture job and displayed the real library symbol in its separate canvas; master displayed three emoji in a modal. | Matched desktop pair below; retained fixture and served-bundle hashes. Controlled service selection demonstrates presentation and targeting, not live AI accuracy. | | No suitable library picture and generation unavailable | Keep the draft usable. The phone app retained the truck emoji, showed one fallback explanation, and enabled Use this board. Browser regression also saved the fallback board, reloaded offline, and found every card. | Matched phone pair below; fallback browser scenario in the [test log](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a003b18d6b91be1f35f7cf62994b0d8eb1819bff/docs/review/pr6-lifecycle/browser.log). | | Stop partial picture work; change source; protect a card; retry a failed save | Stop cancels outstanding jobs without saving a partial draft, restores the prompt, and excludes discarded turns from retry context; source changes wait for an explicit update; protected pictures remain; browser Back/Forward cannot discard a pending save, and retry saves exactly once. The 28 affected Chromium scenarios passed, including offline PNG persistence, reduced motion, keyboard selectors, reload/Back and microphone cleanup. | [Maintained scenarios](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/tree/846311d3ba568630d3f014701a04f2142860abac/tests/web) and the same executed test log; [server cancellation/capacity regression](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/ecb5cea3642a32c8d9edc472f54988f41668f7cb/docs/review/pr6-selection/README.md). | | Inherit Library only/Emoji only on a migrated board; override a board/card; retry slow picture analysis or review | Non-generating modes disable generation and execution sends no generation permission; explicit overrides remain available. Real-SDK/API regressions observed a safe error before the client deadline and a successful retry after server capacity was released, without hidden provider retries. | [Maintained checks and affected policy captures](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a1d42e70ff5dadea9c58d316848cda5c7e607f64/docs/review/pr6-policy/README.md). Timeout tests use controlled fetch and elapsed time, not paid provider calls. | | Save a tile edit; close or stop optional pictures; refine duplicate-label drafts | The saved words survive picture dismissal and reload. Applying pictures uses the saved revision. Different meanings with the same label retain their own pictures after reordering, and each prior picture is reused at most once. | [Three browser save scenarios and two semantic regressions](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a003b18d6b91be1f35f7cf62994b0d8eb1819bff/docs/review/pr6-lifecycle/README.md). | | Read parent privacy settings | Parents can see what goes to OpenAI, what stays on the device, and which picture data remains in the server cache without automatic deletion. | Master-to-final privacy pair below; actual provider/cache behavior inspected. | | Fresh visit to `/`; open the web app | Explain the app before setup. The new homepage links to `/app`; master immediately opens language setup. Browser tests confirmed no homepage library/API initialization and preserved legacy standalone launches. | Matched homepage pair below and landing-page scenarios. | ### Before / After: picture draft **Before:** actual master `5d72992c77fbb09195518e257d799501b7db4d04`. **After captured source:** `02cb85c5e4aaaae056ace73ef6fda591bd0bc500`, captured before the current head `846311d3ba568630d3f014701a04f2142860abac`. Both sides are genuine isolated production builds. Later manual policy/save/privacy and live provider timeout/cancellation changes do not execute in these settled mocked scenes. Picture reuse also does not run in this first-turn, unique-label draft; the captures remain applicable. [Exact impact assessment](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a003b18d6b91be1f35f7cf62994b0d8eb1819bff/docs/review/pr6-lifecycle/README.md). Both isolated production builds used identical synthetic boards, prompts, viewport, light theme, DPR 1, en-US/UTC, fixed Date, and reduced motion. Service workers were blocked; no DOM/CSS hiding or pixel edits. AI/job replies were controlled. The truck is real pinned Mulberry artwork rasterized by the production library path, not a generated mockup. Mulberry Symbols by Steve Lee, CC BY-SA 4.0. [Exact capture manifest, image hashes and running-build verification](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/manifest.json) · [Reproduction, fixture/harness identities and coverage limits](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/README.md). Provenance commit: `7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65`. | Before — modal with generic truck, 1280×900 | After — gap-only library picture and separate canvas, 1280×900 | | --- | --- | | ![Before: master emoji draft](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/before-ready-1280.png?raw=true) | ![After: animal emoji retained and dump-truck picture ready](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/after-ready-1280.png?raw=true) | ### Before / After: unavailable picture Same request and 390×844 phone viewport. Master has no automatic picture service; After explains the unavailable improvement without blocking the usable draft. | Before — emoji draft | After — saveable fallback with one explanation | | --- | --- | | | | ### Before / After: web entry Fresh storage and the same `/` route at 1280×900. The new introduction provides an explicit path into the application. | Before — setup immediately | After — introduction and Open web app | | --- | --- | | ![Before: master language setup at root](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/before-home-1280.png?raw=true) | ![After: website introduction at root](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/after-home-1280.png?raw=true) | ### Before / After: picture-data disclosure **Before:** master `5d72992c77fbb09195518e257d799501b7db4d04`. **After:** current source `846311d3ba568630d3f014701a04f2142860abac`. Same synthetic library, Parent settings privacy section,1280x1000, light/DPR1/en-US/UTC and fixed Date. Real scrolling reveals the complete section; no hiding or edited pixels. The final text adds descriptions and picture pixels sent for matching/review, offline picture storage, and server cache retention. [Exact source/build/fixture provenance and image hashes](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a003b18d6b91be1f35f7cf62994b0d8eb1819bff/docs/review/pr6-lifecycle/manifest.json), bound to evidence commit `a003b18d6b91be1f35f7cf62994b0d8eb1819bff`; [reproduction and scope](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a003b18d6b91be1f35f7cf62994b0d8eb1819bff/docs/review/pr6-lifecycle/README.md). | Before — earlier prompt/audio disclosure | After — picture flow and retention disclosed | | --- | --- | | ![Before: master parent privacy](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a003b18d6b91be1f35f7cf62994b0d8eb1819bff/docs/review/pr6-lifecycle/base-privacy.png?raw=true) | ![After: picture-data privacy disclosure](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a003b18d6b91be1f35f7cf62994b0d8eb1819bff/docs/review/pr6-lifecycle/after-privacy.png?raw=true) | ## Supporting checks and limitations On MCHARTIER_ZBOOK, current source passed release metadata, TypeScript, **203 unit/server tests**, server/web builds, and **28 Chromium picture/conversation scenarios**. These include stopped work, semantic picture reuse, independent tile saves, optional picture apply, failed draft save/retry, repeated Back/Forward, offline PNGs, reduced motion, keyboard controls and microphone cleanup. [Exact checks, behavioral observations and retained evidence](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/a003b18d6b91be1f35f7cf62994b0d8eb1819bff/docs/review/pr6-lifecycle/README.md). The broader **65-scenario Chromium suite** passed on original source `4cdeb323fb8ebfa5247193e47cf73d56f025e007`; unchanged landing-page and unrelated checks are reused with that scope. Current-head [CI passed](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/actions/runs/37362081576). Engineering review, independent QA verdicts and coordinator receipts are recorded separately in the [PR conversation](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/6#discussion_bucket). These are browser captures, not physical-device evidence. Live AI matching/generation accuracy and latency were not re-evaluated; synthetic replies and a real retained library PNG establish the shown behavior. Android/iPad checks remain outstanding. Unsaved conversation drafts remain in memory. The exact API-rendered PR body and embedded image pixels were inspected; full authenticated GitHub-page layout remains unverified because the browser UI tool failed to initialize. No baseline waiver or readiness is implied. Original iteration evidence is retained in the [cleanup record](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/6#issuecomment-6000259404), outside the main base-to-final comparison.

reviewComments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Roll back the turn when stopping picture work**

When the user stops after the text proposal has returned but while pictures are still being prepared, this commits the prompt/reply to `history` and clears `submitted` before the cancellable phase finishes. `cancel()` then restores the previous draft but neither removes that history entry nor restores the prompt, so the transcript describes a discarded update and retrying requires retyping or sends duplicate context. Defer committing the turn until picture preparation completes, or explicitly roll back the history and prompt on cancellation.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Block browser navigation while a draft save is pending**

When a parent presses the browser Back button during `onApply`, this handler immediately clears the draft route and unmounts `AiConversation`, bypassing its `saving.current` guard. If the asynchronous storage write then fails, the error is no longer shown in the conversation and the unsaved draft cannot be retried, so browser history navigation needs to honor the same save-in-progress protection as the page Back button.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update the storage file headers for picture persistence**

Adding the exported PNG store, resolver, and pruning functions makes the file-level header inaccurate because it still says this module keeps only photo and speech files; the equivalent header in `storage.web.ts` likewise omits its new picture store. Update both platform headers so they describe the picture-asset responsibility introduced here.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L3-L6](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/252b863380ee1c76b80a901aafbee6dd92135946/AGENTS.md#L3-L6)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep synchronous picture calls within the client timeout**

When `/api/pictures/analyze` or `/api/pictures/review` takes more than 60 seconds, the mobile `apiFetch` wrapper aborts while this provider can continue for up to 180 seconds, and neither synchronous server handler passes client cancellation to the provider. The app therefore falls back or skips final review even if OpenAI later succeeds, while the abandoned calls continue occupying the server's limited `active` slots and retries can receive 429 responses. Make these operations cancellable/asynchronous or align their timeout with the client.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disable generation for inherited non-generating modes**

On a migrated board with no `picturePolicy`, `CardPicturePreferences` displays the source inherited from `settings.pictureDefaults`, but this disabled check ignores that fallback. If the default is Library only or Emoji only, “Generate new picture” remains enabled; clicking it cannot generate because `prepareBoardPictures` does honor the settings default, and it can instead return the same picture or merely change the emoji and lock the card. Resolve the effective mode with the same board/settings/default chain used by the selector.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Propagate cancellation into picture selection**

When a user stops a job while `provider.select` is evaluating library candidates—or validating the generated image at the second call below—the job's controller is aborted, but `select` accepts no signal and its OpenAI request can continue for the client's 180-second timeout. `run` therefore remains pending and retains its entry in `active`; two stopped jobs can occupy both default worker slots and leave subsequent picture jobs queued until those abandoned selections finish. Pass the job signal through `select` and into the provider request so cancellation releases capacity promptly.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

reviewComments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Document picture data handling in settings**

When automatic matching or generation is used, card concepts and library/generated image pixels are sent to OpenAI, while generated pictures and job metadata remain in the server cache; however, this new in-app picture section mentions only a paid AI service, and the nearby privacy disclosure still enumerates only prompts, recordings, board words, and generated speech. Update the parent-facing privacy text to cover the new picture data flow and retention contract.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L12-L12](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/250d9a055a2c437360227528919d702e8f6196f7/AGENTS.md#L12-L12)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve tile edits when picture preparation is dismissed**

When AI consent is enabled and a parent changes the label, language, or picture options of an unlocked non-photo tile, pressing “Save tile” takes this branch instead of calling `setTiles`. The edited tile exists only inside the temporary `pictures` board, so closing the automatically opened picture sheet—or stopping work and then closing it—silently discards the edit the parent just saved. Commit the tile edit independently or retain it when the picture draft is dismissed.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Match duplicate-label draft pictures one-to-one**

On a follow-up containing multiple new cards with the same label, language, and options but different emoji meanings, every card receives the first matching index because `findIndex` is reused without consuming matches and the signature omits the emoji. For example, two new “Bat” cards distinguished by their emoji can both inherit the first card’s illustration and concept; they are then excluded from `targetIds`, so no analysis or final review corrects the duplicate. Include the visual meaning in the signature and consume matched prior indices.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disclose picture uploads before starter generation**

The remaining first-run path now calls `prepareProposalPictures` before Parent settings is reachable, so pressing “Generate starter boards” sends card descriptions and library/generated picture pixels to OpenAI and leaves pictures, concepts, and job metadata in the server cache. However, the disclosure presented in this flow still says only language choices and board topics are sent and that boards stay on-device. Parents using setup therefore enable this data flow without seeing the accurate disclosure added later in Parent settings; update the setup copy before this action to cover the picture data and retention behavior.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L3-L3](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/846311d3ba568630d3f014701a04f2142860abac/AGENTS.md#L3-L3)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
